lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੬ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ghar 6 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl, Sixth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਜਲੁ ਕੈਹਾ ਚਿਲਕਣਾ ਘੋਟਿਮ ਕਾਲੜੀ ਮਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ujal kaihaa chilakanaa ghotim kaalaRee mas ||
lines.translation: Bronze is bright and shiny, but when it is rubbed, its blackness appears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੋਤਿਆ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhotiaa jooth na utarai je sau dhovaa tis ||1||
lines.translation: Washing it, its impurity is not removed, even if it is washed a hundred times. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੈ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਚਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan seee naal mai chaladiaa naal chala(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: They alone are my friends, who travel along with me;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜੇ ਦਿਸੰਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai tithai khaRe disa(n)n ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: and in that place, where the accounts are called for, they appear standing with me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਠੇ ਮੰਡਪ ਮਾੜੀਆ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਚਿਤਵੀਆਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kothe ma(n)dap maaReeaa paasahu chitaveeaahaa ||
lines.translation: There are houses, mansions and tall buildings, painted on all sides;

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਠੀਆ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਖਣੀਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhatheeaa ka(n)m na aavanhee vichahu sakhaneeaahaa ||2||
lines.translation: but they are empty within, and they crumble like useless ruins. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਸੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bagaa bage kapaRe teerath ma(n)jh vasa(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: The herons in their white feathers dwell in the sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੁਟਿ ਘੁਟਿ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਵਣੇ ਬਗੇ ਨਾ ਕਹੀਅਨੑਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ghut ghut jeeaa khaavane bage naa kaheeanhi ||3||
lines.translation: They tear apart and eat the living beings, and so they are not called white. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿੰਮਲ ਰੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਮੈ ਮੈਜਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: si(n)mal rukh sareer mai maijan dekh bhula(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: My body is like the simmal tree; seeing me, other people are fooled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਫਲ ਕੰਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੑੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਹੰਨੑਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: se phal ka(n)m na aavanhee te gun mai tan ha(n)nhi ||4||
lines.translation: Its fruits are useless - just like the qualities of my body. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੁਲੈ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ਡੂਗਰ ਵਾਟ ਬਹੁਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhulai bhaar uthaaiaa doogar vaat bahut ||
lines.translation: The blind man is carrying such a heavy load, and his journey through the mountains is so long.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਲੋੜੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾ ਹਉ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਾ ਕਿਤੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: akhee loRee naa lahaa hau chaR la(n)ghaa kit ||5||
lines.translation: My eyes can see, but I cannot find the Way. How can I climb up and cross over the mountain? ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਕਰੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਕਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaakareeaa cha(n)giaaeeaa avar siaanap kit ||
lines.translation: What good does it do to serve, and be good, and be clever?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਧਾ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ॥੬॥੧॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam samaal too(n) badhaa chhutahi jit ||6||1||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, contemplate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and you shall be released from bondage. ||6||1||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ਬੇੜੁਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਵਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap kaa ba(n)dh beRulaa jit la(n)ghahi vahelaa ||
lines.translation: Build the raft of meditation and self-discipline, to carry you across the river.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਨਾ ਊਛਲੈ ਐਸਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa saravar naa oochhalai aisaa pa(n)th suhelaa ||1||
lines.translation: There will be no ocean, and no rising tides to stop you; this is how comfortable your path shall be. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਜੀਠੜਾ ਰਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਸਦ ਰੰਗ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa eko naam ma(n)jeethaRaa rataa meraa cholaa sad ra(n)g dholaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Name alone is the color, in which the robe of my body is dyed. This color is permanent, O my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਚਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan chale piaariaa kiu melaa hoee ||
lines.translation: My beloved friends have departed; how will they meet the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਗੰਠੜੀਐ ਮੇਲੇਗਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: je gun hovahi ga(n)thaReeai melegaa soee ||2||
lines.translation: If they have virtue in their pack, the Lord will unite them with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਜੇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai je miliaa hoee ||
lines.translation: Once united with Him, they will not be separated again, if they are truly united.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aavaa gaun nivaariaa hai saachaa soee ||3||
lines.translation: The True Lord brings their comings and goings to an end. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ਸੀਤਾ ਹੈ ਚੋਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar nivaariaa seetaa hai cholaa ||
lines.translation: One who subdues and eradicates egotism, sews the robe of devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹ ਕੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur bachanee phal paaiaa sah ke a(n)mrit bolaa ||4||
lines.translation: Following the Word of the Guru's Teachings, she receives the fruits of her reward, the Ambrosial Words of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਹੁ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai saheleeho sahu kharaa piaaraa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, O soul-brides, our Husband Lord is so dear!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਸਹ ਕੇਰੀਆ ਦਾਸੀਆ ਸਾਚਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ham sah kereeaa daaseeaa saachaa khasam hamaaraa ||5||2||4||
lines.translation: We are the servants, the hand-maidens of the Lord; He is our True Lord and Master. ||5||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਵਾਰਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau bhaa(n)dai bhaau tinaa savaarasee ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are filled with love of the Lord, are blessed and exalted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਸਾਉ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookhee karai pasaau dookh visaarasee ||
lines.translation: They are blessed with peace, and their pains are forgotten.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲੇ ਨਾਹਿ ਸਰਪਰ ਤਾਰਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa moole naahi sarapar taarasee ||1||
lines.translation: He will undoubtedly, certainly save them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਇ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲੀਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinhaa miliaa gur aai jin kau leekhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru comes to meet those whose destiny is so pre-ordained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਦੇਵੈ ਦੀਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har kaa naau devai deekhiaa ||
lines.translation: He blesses them with the Teachings of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਭੀਖਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chaalahi satigur bhaai bhavahi na bheekhiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those who walk in the Will of the True Guru, never wander begging. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਨਿਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau mahal hajoor dooje nivai kis ||
lines.translation: And one who lives in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, why should he bow down to any other?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਦਰਵਾਣੀ ਨਾਹਿ ਮੂਲੇ ਪੁਛ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar daravaanee naahi moole puchh tis ||
lines.translation: The gate-keeper at the Lord's Gate shall not stop him to ask any questions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਦਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chhutai taa kai bol saahib nadar jis ||3||
lines.translation: And one who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace - by his words, others are emancipated as well. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਲੇ ਆਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਤੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghale aane aap jis naahee doojaa matai koi ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself sends out, and recalls the mortal beings; no one else gives Him advice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaahi usaare saaj jaanai sabh soi ||
lines.translation: He Himself demolishes, constructs and creates; He knows everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naau naanak bakhasees nadaree karam hoi ||4||3||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord is the blessing, given to those who receive His Mercy, and His Grace. ||4||3||5||
